title: sesslint-config/v1
description: SessLint configuration: sesslint.toml, .sesslint.toml, or [tool.sesslint] in pyproject.toml. Mirrors the fail-closed key validation in sesslint.config — unknown keys are rejected, and select and ignore cannot both be set.

adapter.description: Input ledger adapter; 'auto' sniffs the first lines.

policy.description: Repair policy: conservative refuses uncertain fixes; salvage additionally extracts a partial ledger when repair is refused.

fail_on.description: Lowest severity that produces a nonzero exit code.

select.description: Rule codes to include (allow-list); when set, only these run. Mutually exclusive with ignore.

ignore.description: Rule codes to suppress from the report. Mutually exclusive with select.

skip_undetected.description: Exit 0 instead of 2 when format detection fails on every input.

confidence_min.description: Minimum detection confidence required to accept a format verdict.

margin_min.description: Minimum confidence margin between the top two format candidates.

max_files.description: Upper bound on files visited during a recursive scan.

max_bytes.description: Maximum cumulative bytes in a directory scan.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for paths excluded from scanning.

ext.description: File extensions scanned in directory mode (e.g. ['.jsonl']).
